raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 payments-source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records and no longer updates the original, so the original stays POSTED. The silver step keeps only status='POSTED', which keeps reversed originals and inflates gold totals. Excluding POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL record (matched via orig_txn_id) should align the totals with settlement.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
